_doc: Orc, stage 1 blockout (silhouette study, route A). Plate over the mass, a two-handed battle axe carried in the right hand, head bare so tusks and personal details read. Shipped gear (Tripo hard pieces + Blender) replaces these piece by piece. Look fix 2026-10-15 (slop audit rows 7, 14): plate is a conformed shell (tools/pipeline/kit_extras.py) so skin cannot poke through; upper arms, neck and head bare (green skin only where he is unarmoured); heavy leather boots; round layered pauldrons and a wide fauld for a brutish silhouette. Round 2 (fresh critic 2026-10-15): named armour parts with their own values (plate breastplate, belt, fauld, mail skirt and thighs, knee cops, greaves, leather boots), a gorget behind the neck, a barrel front.

fauld.doc: wide plate skirt flaring over the hips, below the belt; the breastplate's lower edge sits above the belt

pauldron_l.doc: heavy round pauldron, the orc's brutish shoulder mass

lame_l.doc: a second plate below the pauldron: layered, not one dome

boot_cuff_l.doc: turned-down top of a heavy boot

gorget.doc: round 2 (critic 2026-10-15 item 2): a plate gorget over the trapezius that meets the back of the skull, so the head sits low between the shoulders from every side, not on a stalk from behind

knee_l.doc: knee cop: a lit plate edge between the mail thigh and the greave (critic item 3)

axe.doc: axe in the right fist, haft tipped forward (+X leans the head toward -Y, the body's front) and out so it clears the arm; the head rides above the shoulder, cutting edge leading, spike behind (rev 3: rev 2 leaned the head back and turned the edge out sideways, so the axe read as held backwards)

checks.name: edge leads
checks.claim: the cutting edge faces the way he walks: spike-to-blade points forward

checks.name: head forward of the grip
checks.claim: the axe head leans forward of the fist, never back over the shoulder

checks.name: head above the grip
checks.claim: the axe is carried head up, the head above the fist

cuirass.doc: barrel breastplate and backplate over chest, back and neck; the bulge swells chest and gut forward so the heavy leads with his front (critic item 4: the profile read as a hunchback)

skirt.doc: mail skirt under the fauld: a darker value than plate, so the breastplate's edge reads (critic item 3)

vambraces.doc: rerebraces and vambraces: bare upper arms between pauldron and vambrace read as moss patches at 1x

thighs.doc: mail chausses over the thighs (darker than plate)

greaves.doc: plate greaves: lit plate between the knee cop and the boot

boots.doc: heavy leather boots over a broad short foot (bodies.json bone_scale keeps the toes inside the 12 px pivot tolerance)

eyes.doc: his brow ridge juts forward: the eyes push further out to read under it from the 45 degree camera
